notes.title: Gunslinger's Paradise: John Cooper reveals Desperados III's release date!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33465443/107a5b8f19ea7c09e9ca6aa28faa96e507986d22.jpg

He's almost quicker to the draw than his own shadow, and his bullets always hit their mark. When the smoke from his revolvers slowly clears, you can read it clearly: JUNE. 16. 2020. Yeeehaw, folks! Desperados III finally has a release date, presented by the notorious gunslinger John Cooper himself. 

So shoot it into your calendars, Desperados III will be available for PC, Xbox One™ and PlayStation®4 on June 16th, 2020. 

Watch the brandnew John Cooper Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jwyYiURDMtY

Desperados III is available for pre-order now on PC at an SRP of € 49.99 / $ 49.99 / £ 44.99 (PC). 

For the early adopters: The Digital Deluxe Edition is available for pre-order for the price of the Standard Edition during this pre-order phase! Make sure to shoot first, and ask questions later.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/610370/

Enjoy & stay tuned!
Your Mimimi Games & THQ Nordic Teams

notes.title: Update: Modern System Compatibility (Win8, Win10, Mac and Linux support) and Demo Level added!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5309406/efad5d17a3d9d49fd642f5bc2cf772e7fbe73157.jpg
Dear Desperados Fans,

We are happy to tell you that Desperados - Wanted Dead or Alive now runs well on modern operating systems:
Windows 7 / 8 / 10
New: Mac and Linux support!

Includes a long lost demo mission where Cooper, Doc and Kate free a town from Outlaws.
A challenging level from back in the old days when some games still had rather difficult demos
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5309406/86db8c1afdf65e9ca8ddc7a7f7d264dcdd0abeeb.jpg

Language selection has been added in game.
Main game: French, German, Spanish, Italian, Russian, English
Demo mission: French, German, Spanish, English

Enjoy the update and let us know your thoughts in the forum or the brand new Desperados discord channel:
https://discord.gg/KR96Z9K

Cheers,
Your THQ Nordic Team
